title: Experience opens a pause in perspective
meaning: Suspending familiar action through understood experience can emotionally become a suspension of an earlier judgement about events.
text: The Hanged Man appears in different positions in this Energy Field. In the physical position, it concerns suspending a familiar shared action for another perspective; in emotions, it describes experiencing a judgement at a standstill, when a familiar view temporarily stops explaining events. The Hermit in energy gives a motive to draw on understood experience and share what has become clear. The overall tone can be concentrated: you act differently and also feel the unfamiliarity of a perspective that emerged through attention to what you have already experienced.

For example, you postpone the usual attempt to finish a family chronology and return to old notes. Earlier mistakes suggest examining who made the records and when. You discover that one story may have had several accounts. **We suspended the work and felt our judgement of a familiar story begin to change.** Emotional suspension concerns another perspective; it does not mean that involvement in the shared activity has disappeared.

A difficulty appears if the new view is declared definitively deeper and immediate acceptance is demanded. Understood experience again becomes a prepared answer on someone else’s behalf. Or the two pauses are taken to require endless waiting. The repeated Hanged Man does not intensify an obligation to endure uncertainty, and the Hermit guarantees no infallible account. Practical suspension and emotional reconsideration can have different durations and meanings for the two people involved.
